home.title: Askapeer
home.tagline: The No Ego Sports Medicine Network

auth.legalName: Full name (as on your professional register)
auth.checkEmailBody: We've sent you a secure sign-in link. There is no password.
auth.anonymityNotice: Askapeer is pseudonymous. Your real name and details are never shown to other members. Attempting to identify yourself or anyone else results in immediate, permanent removal — no exceptions.

pending.title: We're verifying your registration
pending.body: This usually takes a short while. We'll email you the moment it's done — you can close this page.

awaitingCapture.title: One step left
awaitingCapture.body: We need to check your ID to confirm you're the person on the register. It takes a minute.

needs_more_info.title: We need a little more information
needs_more_info.body: Your verification couldn't be completed. You can pick up where you left off.

approved_verified.title: You're verified
approved_verified.body: Welcome to Askapeer. Next you'll choose the pseudonymous handle you'll be known by.

rejected.title: We couldn't verify your registration
rejected.body: You can register again with corrected details.

default.title: Your account status has changed
default.body: Please check your email for details.

identityCheck.title: Confirm your identity
identityCheck.body: We check your ID document against the name on your professional register. Your documents are never shown to other members.
identityCheck.providerUnavailable: Identity checks are temporarily unavailable. We'll email you when you can continue.

noSession.title: Nothing to do here
noSession.body: There's no identity check waiting on you right now.

simulated.prompt: Stands in for the Onfido capture step. Choose the result the provider should return:
simulated.abandonHint: To simulate an abandoned check, just leave this page — the applicant is surfaced for review once the check times out.
